title: Asset Inventory
description: A compact inventory enriched from existing authorized NetOps evidence. No additional network scan is started here.

filters.searchPlaceholder: Hostname, IP, MAC, vendor, or OS

insights.title: Asset Insights
insights.compactHint: Expand summaries and filter the inventory
insights.empty: Evidence-backed summaries will appear when normalized evidence is available.

detail.title: Asset details
detail.confidenceHelp: Confidence in OS classification based on available network evidence. Private or randomized MAC evidence lowers confidence where applicable.
detail.vendorHelp: Vendor is estimated from MAC and other available device evidence. Some devices may remain Unknown.
detail.noServices: No bounded port or service evidence is available.
detail.noLinks: No related NetOps destination is available for this asset yet.

empty.title: No assets match this view
empty.description: Clear the filters or wait until an authorized integration adds inventory records.

unconfigured.title: Asset Inventory is not configured
unconfigured.description: The local PostgreSQL asset connection has not been enabled on this environment.

unavailable.title: Asset Inventory is unavailable
unavailable.description: The local backend could not load the inventory. Existing NetOps features remain unaffected.
